title: FILO: A Unified Fisher-Geometric Framework for Low-Rank Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2605.08734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reparameterizes a weight matrix $W$ as a product of two low-rank factors, but the Jacobian $J_G$ of the generator mapping the factors to the weight matrix is rank-deficient, so the factor-space preconditioner $J_G^* F_t J_G$ induced by any $W$-space preconditioner $F_t$ is singular, and consequently the standard chain rule cannot be uniquely inverted to map a preconditioned $W$-space direction back to a factor-space update. Therefore, we introduce FILO, a unified Fisher-geometric framework for low-rank adaptation that enables factor updates without directly inverting this singular operator and casts existing LoRA optimizers by their factor-space inversion strategy and $W$-space preconditioner $F_t$. Existing methods occupy four families along these axes: factor-space adaptive updates, block-diagonal surrogates for $J_G^* J_G$, Frobenius-residual pseudoinverse methods, and Riemannian manifold methods.

translated_title: FILO：低秩自适应的统一Fisher几何框架
translated_abstract: 低秩自适应（LoRA）将权重矩阵 $W$ 重参数化为两个低秩因子的乘积，但将因子映射到权重矩阵的生成器的雅可比矩阵 $J_G$ 是秩亏的，因此由任何 $W$ 空间预条件子 $F_t$ 诱导的因子空间预条件子 $J_G^* F_t J_G$ 是奇异的，进而导致标准链式法则无法被唯一地求逆，无法将预条件后的 $W$ 空间方向映射回因子空间的更新。为此，我们提出了 FILO，一个用于低秩自适应的统一 Fisher 几何框架，它无需直接对该奇异算子求逆即可实现因子更新，并根据因子空间求逆策略和 $W$ 空间预条件子 $F_t$ 对现有 LoRA 优化器进行分类。现有方法沿着这两个维度划分为四大类：因子空间自适应更新、$J_G^* J_G$ 的块对角替代方法、Frobenius 残差伪逆方法以及黎曼流形方法。
tldr: 本文提出FILO，一个统一的Fisher几何框架，无需对奇异算子直接求逆即可实现LoRA的因子空间更新，并据此将现有LoRA优化器系统地划分为四大类。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FILO, a unified Fisher-geometric framework that enables LoRA factor updates without directly inverting the singular operator and systematically categorizes existing LoRA optimizers into four families.
